generated.description: A large sailing galleon named after Peter the Great, built as a multi-deck wooden warship with white wool and magenta sails and a tall stern. It is about 42 wide, 81 high and 102 deep, made mostly of spruce and oak planks, slabs and fences, with black and red terracotta accents and glass windows. The build has no interior block entities, so chests are only decorative; the source gives no description beyond its title.
